Awtomated TBMS launched Intelligent Workflow and AI Automation for LSPs

Release 1.22.0 eliminates manual task creation while maintaining user flexibility. The platform now offers a few predefined automations with plans to expand to 50-100 templates. The automation options cover common translation workflows, including applying Microsoft, DeepL or Translation Memory Machi
